title: Native FAQ Accordion
prompt: Build the FAQ accordion for a product page: at least three sibling <details> elements that all share the same name="faq" (opening one closes the others), each with a non-empty <summary> question and answer content after the summary. No JavaScript anywhere.

tests.name: three or more sibling details
tests.hint: Every FAQ entry is one <details> with a <summary> and the answer as content.

tests.name: accordion name shared by all
tests.hint: The shared name attribute is the whole trick: same name = exclusive accordion, per details.

tests.name: every summary is non-empty
tests.hint: The summary is what gets announced and clicked — it must carry the visible question.

tests.name: answers live after the summary
tests.hint: Content that is not the <summary> is the disclosed answer — each item needs one.
